description: This file defines jQuery's offset module, including functions for setting and getting element offsets, position, offset parent, and scroll methods, with dependencies on core, CSS, and selector modules.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the window object associated with an element, or the element itself if it is a window.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset of an element based on provided options.

methods.name: offset
methods.description: Gets or sets the offset of the first element in the jQuery collection.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Calculates the position of the element relative to its offset parent.

methods.name: offsetParent
methods.description: Returns the closest offset parent of the element.
